tests.assertion: test('4956/2153真实起初始化、无谋死战阶清敌回合，有自身异常且清除成功反馈语义待答回滚',()=>{const s=make({move:38589,soul:true});turn(s,38589,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],undefined);const x=make({move:38589,soul:true});x.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;assert.throws(()=>turn(x,38589,20117),/Q-4956-003/);assert.equal(x.round,1);});

tests.name: 4956/2153已持谋死的自身最优范围复用待答阻断，ABC异常匹配与D视致死未猜造
tests.assertion: test('4956/2153已持谋死的自身最优范围复用待答阻断，ABC异常匹配与D视致死未猜造',()=>{const s=make({move:38589,soul:true});s.fighters[1].soulState.murder2153=[0];assert.throws(()=>turn(s,38589,20117),/Q-4921-003/);for(const[n,k,q]of[[0,'害怕','Q-4956-001'],[1,'流血','Q-4956-001'],[2,'诅咒','Q-4956-001'],[3,'中毒','Q-4956-002']]){const x=make({move:38589,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.t.soulState.murder2153=[n];c.t.ailments[k]=3;}},()=>turn(x,38589,20117)),new RegExp(q));assert.equal(x.round,1);}});

tests.name: 4956/2153谋死持有者正常完整致死伤害推进各阶段并真实授免异或免攻，保1HP不要求实际死亡，恰等HP不推进
tests.assertion: test('4956/2153谋死持有者正常完整致死伤害推进各阶段并真实授免异或免攻，保1HP不要求实际死亡，恰等HP不推进',()=>{for(const phase of[0,1,2,3]){const s=make({move:38589,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:100});const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153;st.phase=phase;st.transitions=phase;timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.t.soulState.murder2153=[phase];c.hurt(c.t,1000,'正常致死伤害非谋死替换','fixed');}},()=>turn(s,38589,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,phase+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.transitions,phase+1);if(phase===0)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);if(phase===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardRed,1);if(phase===2)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.guardAttack,1);}const x=make({move:38589,index:-1,soul:true,targetHp:100});timer(x,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});timer(x,1,'攻击伤害免疫');watch((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.t.soulState.murder2153=[0];c.hurt(c.t,100,'等于伤前HP','fixed');}},()=>turn(x,38589,20117));assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.plot2153.phase,0);});

tests.name: 4956/2153每实际推进一次受红减少10，免攻次数真实消费且后续有HP损失，免异用统一来源账本

tests.assertion: test('4956/1619复用已答复制完整敌已用技能、原槽PP与一次前判定，先手不复制，1673失败255下限与成功秒杀',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({move:29484,index:0,aStats:{spe:1},seed:seed*987654321,hp:1000});turn(s,29484,10127);const copied=s.fighters[0].soulState.copyIdentityAudit16194658;if(copied){seen.add('copy');assert.equal(copied.copied,10127);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}else{seen.add('failure');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000-sum(s,'attack',1)+4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-1);}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(29484)],9);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);const first=make({move:29484,index:0,hp:1000});turn(first,29484,20117);assert.equal(first.fighters[0].hp,1000);const chance=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32&&chance.size<2;seed++){const x=make({move:29484,index:1,seed:seed*987654321});turn(x,29484,20117);chance.add(x.fighters[1].hp===0);if(x.fighters[1].hp>0)assert.equal(sum(x),0);}assert.equal(chance.size,2);});
